title: Optical-input model dependence in Geant4 light-collection corrections: a NaI(Tl) case study — code and data
description:
Geant4 application, optical models, digitised inputs, run records, analysis scripts and manuscript source for the paper of the same title. Every number in the manuscript is produced by the scripts from the files in this archive and asserted against its source by scripts/check_paper_numbers.py.

Code is released under the MIT licence; data, material tables, run records and the manuscript text and figures under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA).
